integrity: The proof establishes an all-exponent theorem; finite checks are corroboration, not infinite certification. Prior 3-adic interpolation and periodicity are credited to earlier work.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard derangement sequence at p=3 is classified. It gives the attained-value set, not multiplicities or other primes. Historical novelty remains qualified; an independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Exact ternary residue spectrum and Haar measure of derangement numbers
